verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model and hosted fine-tuning platform with an API, CLI and dashboard, so a recurring job scheduler is a plausible feature to ask about. The evidence only shows one-off API calls (generations, uploads, training submissions) and an 'Automation Foundation Model' for tool-calling. Nothing documents recurring schedules, cron-like triggers or scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
